text:
samir: Morning — day 2 here, quick security q's. Do I need FileVault/BitLocker turned on before the phishing sim? My Mac reports FileVault: OFF. Should I run `fdesetup enable` or will IT do it? Also, can I take the phishsim/training on my personal laptop for now or do I need a company device? Who handles exceptions? thanks

it-support: hey @samir — welcome! FileVault should be enabled on company-managed devices before you finish onboarding. For personal laptops we prefer you use a company loaner for the graded phishsim. If your Mac is enrolled in Jamf we can push the enable remotely. Can you run `fdesetup status` and paste the output?

samir: here's the output: `FileVault is Off`. Running macOS 13.4.1. I enrolled in Jamf last night but didn't see a prompt about encryption.

it-support: ok. If Jamf shows enrolled we can push it. Could you also run `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep 'Serial Number'` and DM the serial? Alternatively we can schedule a quick remote screen-share and do it for you.

security-bot: FYI @phil: phishing simulation for new joiners is scheduled next Tue 03/30 — completion required within 7 days. Personal devices are not allowed for graded sims per policy. See https://intranet.redwood/sec/onboarding/phishsim for details.

priya: tagging @it-support & @jordan (security) — for exceptions like remote contractors we review on a case-by-case basis. @samir you don't need to take any manual action beyond the status check; we'll follow up once IT confirms.

jordan: quick note from security: if Jamf can't toggle FileVault, do not enable manually until we confirm escrow of the recovery keys. If you enabled manually they might not be escrowed. We escrow keys to our KMS. If Jamf can't enable, the manual command would be `sudo fdesetup enable -user $(whoami)`, but wait for IT to confirm escrow. I'll look into your device enrollment this afternoon.

samir: good to know — I won't enable it myself. DMing serial now. Also how does the phishing training get assigned? LMS link or separate email?

priya: LMS (Learn) auto-assigns the security training within 24 hours of account activation. If you don't see it by EOD tomorrow ping me and I'll nudge it. Phishsim (the simulated phishing) is handled by Security and is a separate scheduled send.

it-support: got the serial, pushing FileVault enable via Jamf now. You may get a prompt to restart and a Jamf policy run. We'll also ensure the recovery key is escrowed. ETA ~30m. :thumbsup:

samir: :raised_hands: awesome, thanks. One more quick one — do I need GlobalProtect VPN set up immediately or only when accessing production infra?

it-support: please install GlobalProtect and connect via Okta SSO for any network-restricted resources. Use the install link: https://tools.redwood/setup/globalprotect. We'll include VPN in the remote session so we can verify connectivity.
